summary.final_text:
I added 150 µL of PBS buffer to each of assay_plate wells A1, A2 and A3.

I used one tip from tips:A1 for all three transfers, since it was all from the same PBS source. Each step was 150 µL, and the tip was empty when I dropped it. The PBS stock dropped from 40,000 µL to 39,550 µL, which matches the 450 µL dispensed. I did not verify the well volumes on the plate itself, because the device list doesn't report working wells.

task_def.source: Basic plate set-up: dispensing buffer into wells, the first step of most plate assays.
